column1: # Event UUID vectors: UUIDv5(namespace, name + NUL + hashed signature).
# Read by tests/static/events_registry.py (C and Python) and
# Tab-separated: namespace, name, signature as written, canonical hashed part, expected UUID.
# The signature may be empty or hold spaces; the hashed part may be empty. Lines starting
# with # are comments. Do not change a row's UUID: a change means identity moved.
# The extended grammar: bool is u8 for identity; ptr<T>, ptr<str>, ptr<int[len]> and int[N]
# hash as written (canonical: no spaces, N without leading zeros).
